prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1159; do not mention it.)
text: On arrival at the scene of a rear-end collision in Houston, Texas, officers observed two passenger vehicles in the right lane of a northbound roadway with visible rear damage to the vehicle identified as Driver 2. Driver 1 stated that traffic ahead had slowed suddenly and that Driver 2 did not stop in time, striking the rear bumper of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 stated that they were following at a normal distance and that Driver 1 braked abruptly. Both drivers were conscious and able to communicate. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was transported by EMS for evaluation. A Passenger seated in the rear of Driver 1's vehicle reported neck stiffness but declined transport. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review of the statements and vehicle positions. Weather was clear and the pavement was dry at the time of the collision.
